items.title: CMG Q3 deep dive: digital engagement, menu innovation, and international expansion drive growth
items.summary: Mexican fast-food chain Chipotle (NYSE:CMG) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 9.6% year on year to $3.29 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.27 per share was 7.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
